articles.title: President Erdogan says NATO summit 'successfully' concluded, highlights Türkiye's defense capabilities
articles.summary: Erdoğan stated that the 2026 NATO summit in Ankara concluded successfully as a historic gathering that will shape the alliance's future during heightened security challenges.

articles.title: President Erdogan gives NATO leaders book on his leadership, Türkiye's transformation
articles.summary: Erdoğan presented NATO leaders with an English-language book on his political career and Türkiye's transformation at a dinner following the NATO summit in Ankara.

articles.title: CANLI- Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan konuşuyor
articles.summary: Live coverage of President Erdoğan delivering a speech.

articles.title: Cumhurbaşkanı Erdoğan: Anlaşmanın uygulamalarını takip edecek, görev gücünde Türkiye olarak inşallah biz de yer alacağız
articles.summary: Erdoğan stated that Türkiye will monitor the implementation of the Gaza ceasefire agreement and participate in the monitoring mechanism.
